about: The producer public keys that sign Carbon's sealed exams, one per network, pinned in the release a validator installs (Validator, E4 condition 1). A validator accepts exam packages signed only by the key pinned for the network it is installed on: a network with no entry refuses (exam_producer_wrong_network) and a network whose key is not yet set refuses (exam_producer_unregistered), so a mainnet install never trusts the testnet key and no key ever serves two networks. An exam-source file never supplies a key. Each entry names the decision that set it; an entry changes only by a reviewed commit.
